label: Necessary-support union WF from actual WF and necessary-source path transport
description: Compose the existing presentSupportWF with the library WellFounded.transGen theorem. Each all-world union edge between necessary concrete endpoints maps to a NONEMPTY actual guarded path with those SAME endpoints. Subrelation well-foundedness then yields the existing union-WF premise. No worldwise-to-union inference, frame reflexivity, J1, EM or necessary-source supply is inserted.
